amendment.scope: replace only sensitivity calculation and aggregate/frequency decision gates; V1 and cohort remain immutable

decision_rules.LOCAL_CONFLICT_DEPRIORITIZED: sensitivity-adjusted rotation-marker aggregate lower bound > 0 AND sensitivity-adjusted negative-frequency upper bound < 0.5
decision_rules.LOCAL_CONFLICT_SUPPORTED: sensitivity-adjusted rotation-marker aggregate upper bound < 0 AND sensitivity-adjusted negative-frequency lower bound > 0.5
decision_rules.MIXED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, including an aggregate or frequency sensitivity bound crossing its threshold

estimands.primary: per-pair cosine(g_FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL, g_MARKER_BINDING_CONTROL), averaged within canonical base then equally across the 12 bases
secondary: LoRA module and layer squared-norm contributions

execution.objective: same E04-C production serializer and all-assistant CE

frozen_cohort.selection: one hash-selected legitimate TRAIN base per allowed structural cell; all four turns

scientific_question: At exact V7 start, do matched fixed-turn rotation and marker-binding LoRA gradients show locally antagonistic directions?

bootstrap.unit: canonical base with all four turns resampled together

repeats.aggregate_envelope: [max(-1,L-U_AB),min(1,H+U_AB)]; observed-repeatability sensitivity envelope, not confidence interval or global numerical guarantee
repeats.condition_radius: delta_condition=max observed delta_c for that condition
repeats.negative_frequency: per rotation-marker pair: definitely negative iff cosine+U<0; definitely nonnegative iff cosine-U>=0; otherwise ambiguous. Resample canonical bases with all four turns together; lower frequency treats ambiguous as nonnegative, upper treats ambiguous as negative.
repeats.rows: lexicographically first matched pair; bind canonical_base_id, pair_id, turn, and each three task hashes before model loading
repeats.scale_variation: report separately and never use in sign classification
